reviews.x: This game is fun to play, however the only thing that is irritating is trying to get gems. They’re already difficult enough to get in game unless you pay real money for it, and they don’t give out enough whenever you level up. if your open to feedback, please consider changing the amount of gems you get after leveling up from 7 to at least 10-15.
Love it

I tried opening it, but it said I had to reload and try again. I tried the next day, and all my progress was gone. This has happened three times, can you please fix it. Still a good game if this wasn't happening.

Why do I get an ad after every single level I complete? This game is predatory it might as well just be called Ad Fever instead of Cooking Fever. And to think with so many ads they would have a “no more ads” purchase available and they don’t. There is no reason I should be getting an ad after every level when I’m just playing a normal game, Candy Crush wouldn’t do this. Do yourself a favour and don’t download this game and download Crazy Hospital instead there are no ads unless you choose to watch them.

What’s up with the server? Keeps getting a message, can’t connect to server Try again in 15 minutes. Just paid 14 diamonds to compete in a challenge and now it won’t let me play. I can access everything else via the internet, so definitely a Cooking Fever issue… what a rip off Give me back my diamonds :(

1/18/23 Notice all the one word 5 star reviews propping up the rating? 🤔😡 Server has been down for a couple of hours. While I'm here...I don't get notifications until I open the app. I lose a lot of plants because I don't get notifications and gee, I have to work for a living, so I can't constantly check. Often freezes during ads. 2/19/18 Need more levels! Can you make the font for the upgrades a little bigger?

I have had this game for darn near 10 years. It was much better before. Now you have to pay to collect money from your own businesses, you can only get bonuses from your login, it is incredibly difficult to get gems (which you need more and more as the game progresses) You cannot finish all levels without investing gems in them. It has gotten ridiculous how mush they have taken from the game and just pushing for you to give them money. I'm very disappointed in all the changes. It WAS my favorite

The forced ads after every level will crash your game every time. To remove forced ads, you can make a purchase but that only removes them for a LIMITED TIME! Which is not pointed out in the fine print or anywhere else. Not worth the purchase, barely worth playing.

Such a delightful game. I recently managed to dig up a memory from my childhood of this game so I decided to try it out agian. And it's exactly like I remember! It doesn't push you an ungodly amount of payment offers either, and the only ads are ones you choose to watch to get in-game currency, and some cheeky ones playing on some screens as scenery. Personally, I think the second one is pretty creative. I would definitely recommend trying this game for a bit If you have some time to kill.

I'm addicted to this game but I decided to change from 5* to 2* and now to 1* because of unbearable unskippable ads. Why don't they just make a paid version with no ads at all instead of a free version with a lot of ads.. And now they scam you to pay the in app purchase to remove forced adds but they didn't mentionned that is only for limited time. Seems like this game do whatever to make you pay for gems to pass the level

love this game, very detailed and well made, but I hate the gem and gardening system. you are given very little gems which are needed to upgrade stuff which lets you actually complete levels and move forward in the game, therefore I just get stuck. and with the gardening system, if you don't return very frequently with no warnings, all your plants die very easily, and it ends up being a waste of good rewards.

The longer and longer you play the more you will need to pay. Oh, they say it's free to play, but only if you don't want to advance at a decent rate. Added a new fun feature of gardening! It's soul purpose is another thing to spend Gems on so that you have to buy more in order to play decently. I've been playing this game for years off and on. Always end up uninstall cause I just can't afford how expensive this game is or have the pacients for the slowest dungeon crawl ever made.

This has been a fun game! The new gardens feature is frustrating. You grow plants for rewards, but 3 times I didn't receive the reward promised after my plant matured. I have submitted 3 support requests since this feature was added and none have been resolved. You can always earn the coins by replaying levels. But gems are hard to come buy and recently even harder. The game sometimes to give a gift on it's birthday or a holiday. I always enjoyed those!

Too many ads and the feature that allowed you to collect coins on the restaurants you've already completed, is no longer there. I did make note of the retarded daily prizes each day, which does allow you to collect coins worth 1K, 2K, or 3K, but that's still not the same as collecting the daily revenue (ranging in 2K to 3K) from ALL of your stores that you've completed all 40 levels with. Oh well, as the saying goes, nothing good lasts forever. Greedy money hungry game developers.

Fun game! Like any game, it has its kinks, it's takes awhile to load, freezes, sometimes when you watch an add for shards, which add up to gems, the game doesn't give you your reward. I did notify them of this issue, and they responded within 48 hours, which was nice. They simple just game me a few gems 💎 and that was it.

Great game, but way too money hungry. 7 gems for levelling up is way too low, considering some single upgrades can be as expensive as 10 gems per tier. Casino can be very frustrating when you spend over 30-50k coins without getting gems. Replaying levels over and over just to get gems can get boring very quickly. Please consider fixing this. It's a fun game, but It will be more profitable for you in the long run, and happy loyal gamers would be more likely to purchase packs and support you.

I really like this game, but there are some challenges when completing every other level. Regardless of what restaurant you own, each time I finish a level, it will provide credit when completing the next level. It finishes the level and then nothing happens. So, each time I finish a level, I have to completely exit the game and come back in. the other challenge is that I am not able to access the Casino. Whenever I click on it, it just moves my cursor to another restaurant to purchase.

This game is really Fun. It starts off slowly. I almost deleted it. But be patient, You earn money quickly after the first few rounds. The money gives you choices and makes the game really fast- paced. However, i do not know why they call it "Korean Food". So far i am ssrving Hamburgers, hot dogs, french fries, and cola. Maybe it will be Korean Food later. Nevertheless i like the game.

Dragging the food is difficult and let's go and sometimes doesn't grab then the food burns. Frustrating. Also spent 10 diamonds on the automatic food cooker and it lasted 2 levels!!!??? And 2 of the easiest levels where you don't even need it. Thought it would last at least 72 hours?!? Used to be a great game but you can tell it's now been modified to get your money :(

I used to really like this game and I've had it downloaded for years. I just started playing it again today after being offline for a few months and noticed how much the game had changed. Boosters have now been added but I liked that this game was unique compared to many others and didn't have extras such as boosters, as now it's just like other games. Now it's nearly impossible to serve all customers as the wait time has randomly decreased meaning I've to do more upgrades. Might uninstall it.

Love the fact you don't have to wait for energy to reload like most cooking games. The first 40 levels are great, but it becomes impossible to play without spending real cash, and not just a bit which I don't mind, but a LOT to even attempt to upgrade the restaurants because if you don't upgrade it becomes unplayable. Really disappointing on that point.

The game used to be challenging enough with the upgrades requiring gems,which are very hard to get. Now it's just impossible, the boosters aren't doing anything, gems are just as hard to get, and levels can't be passed no matter how well you do. The fast food place, where I have most of the upgrades, INCLUDING the autocooker, I can only get two stars on the last level despite always serving customers immediately. This is a commercial move to make you buy gems and boosters. It's not cool.

Kitchen upgrades & automatic machines unlock without reaching a certain level. Because of that tutorials doesn't appear anymore. Fast food restaurant should be the easiest restaurant to get 3 stars but now it's the opposite. New boosters doesn't really help, just another way for the developers to earn money. Would be really great if the game doesn't need to be connected to the internet when playing.

This game is good until you get past the food court and purchase another restaurant. Almost everything you try to upgrade costs so many gems. This wouldn't be that bad of it was maybe 1 or 2 for the more important things but when your spending more gems on a small upgrade than what you actually spend on the restaurant itself then its just gets stupid. I can't complete levels without upgrading more things but I need gems that i don't have. And I'm not taking part in competitions that I won't win.

This is a very enjoyable game, and I've liked it since I was probably 7, there are multiple levels, restaurants, and upgrades so you never run out. My only problem is gems. Gems are very difficult to earn unless you use real money. Anther thing I dislike is how you have to earn 9 gems before you even get 1. Some levels are impossible to win without spending multiple gems. I've tired many ways to earn them including giveaways and tournaments but it's still extremely difficult.

love this game... even got my sister to play, it passes time quickly. .......slightly addictive!! I'm a perfectionist at most things, so I always want to play every level until it's perfect, which makes some levels more challenging! Wish there was a way to obtain diamonds more easily. The casino is cool, but takes way too many times to win anything worth the amount of coins your spending to achieve what your playing for to begin with. The payout isnt really worth it in the end. But it is a fun!

Very fun game. This game is SUPER heavy in terms of content and how much you could do. Unfortunately, the reason why I don't give it more than 3 stars is simply because of the GEMS. They're very hard to obtain (Like, you only get very few leveling up and that takes a lot of grinding. How can you grind if you don't have the necessary upgrades to move on?) So trying to unlock new places or simply moving on is super hard. Overall fun and addictive but the gem system could be nerfed..

I love this game, I recently redownloade it after a year or a few months it brings back so many memories. However, it is not always paid to win, and the whole money and diamond crisis depends on how you save and spend. So far I have made immense progress and have not paid to win. The ads pop up subtle,in my opinion. Everyone is entitled to their opinion, but for new players seeking to download, here is some advice. Download it see for yourself. It is about how you play the game, your preference.

This game is fun, but it's way too hard to get gems after the first level. All of the upgrades cost gems but you can only get them by leveling up, playing the stupid lottery game, or buying them. At that point you can't upgrade anything and then you're stuck playing the same level over and over. I think at least you should get two gems per level if the upgrades are going to cost gems. If I get a response from the game maker about earning gems through Instagram, that's dumb, make your game better

Love this game. But the gems ruin it all. You don't know which restaurant you should buy first, and when you buy it, you can't progress because of the gems. I had some friends who had this game as well, and all of them uninstalled because of the same reason. You need to make it easier to progress. Maybe everytime you finish a level to earn 1-3 diamonds(depends on how many stars you've gotten maybe), so it'll be easier and much more fun.

I LOVE IT! (5/12/15) Edit (4/1/23): Cooking Fever is nearly impossible to play nowadays. (Shorter customer waiting times even after upgrades, less diamonds after leveling up, and no more income from places you own. Which is a weird thing to get rid of. (Almost as if they felt like we were earning too much money from owned places) They've made it wheres though buying currency is the only way to get by compared to back then when completing levels gave you enough diamonds to at least upgrade too.

The gameplay is very nice, but after completing the first restaurant, the economy quickly changes and you're forced to use diamonds in order to get 3 stars in the later levels. Upgrades also become hard to do. With only getting diamonds form the daily challenges (if you're lucky), leveling up, or from the casino (which rarely gives you diamonds), they are forcing you to pay real money to advance. This breaks the fun of the game. Wasted potential!

This game is really enjoyable to play when I'm killing time. But there's some issue going on. It's called a progress roll back issue or something. And this happened so many times. More than twice, really. And I can't play the game properly. I just uninstalled it. And installed it again. But suddenly this happens. Progresses getting erased. Rollback issues that happens uncontrollably. And the game app itself closing. Please fix this problem. I really want to enjoy this game properly.

I payed over 11 dollars in the game only for everything to be taken away, and everything reset as if I didn't progress any in the game. I went from rank 12 to rank 3, mind you by now I've beat an entire resturant and was halfway through another one and I decided to buy some extra coins and gems, I click off the game only to click back on it to see everything was taken away and I couldn't get my money back. So yea, this game kinda pissed me off. I wasted 11 dollars on nothing.

Just started it but so far, no complaints. (5 stars) Update: while I love the game, I had to remove 2 stars because it has gotten ridiculous from the second restaurant. Gems are hard to come by, yet the upgrades (a must if you want to win), cost WAY MORE gems than you can ever obtain. They're clearly trying to get you to pay for the gems which is disappointing. I dont mind paying, but at least make it fair/reasonable. I had to uninstall because even if I wanted to pay, it's too expensive.

Used to absolutely adore this game, so fun! I saw that I gave it 5 stars back in 2016 and have returned to it again and again, however (as is a trend with this gaming company it seems) it has since turned into a complete money grab, making it not even half the experience it was. The gems are much too often required. Only two completed restaurants (out of 35) and I'm at a point where I've literally progressed as much as I can without spending. Well done capitalism, CANT RECOMMEND

Had a 5-star rating because the game is fun, but it's constantly annoying me. I check in daily to get my daily rewards, hoping to get that gift towards the end of the month. Every time the gift is the next item to be received, it doesn't let me collect it, having the locked icon still showing as if I've already collected my gift that day (when clearly I haven't, the date says so).

I was addicted to this game. I'm talking hours playing a day. Eventually, you need gems to upgrade EVERYTHING. And you NEED to upgrade after certain levels to even earn enough to pass the round. So unless you are willing to spend hundreds of your hard earned money (which unfortunately I have), the game gets un-playable. I'm done spending my hard earned money when this game is clearly only about how much they can take from you. No realistic fair chance to even earn enough gems.

The gameplay is interesting, but the fact is, as the levels progress, it is not possible to pass them if you do not buy diamonds. The whole game is just money taker, and it is not designed for fun and play, but for the frustration that will finally force you to pay for the diamonds. Because of that, without paying, it becomes boring very fast. Dissapointing.

Good game. Except for the ads. You can't skip them, and then the screen goes black and you have to close the app and go back in. Every time. Makes the gameplay not fun. I paid for a cheap package just to get rid of the ads. The get free stuff by watching an ad does the same thing. Is that the dev's intention? To force us to spend? Didn't used to be that way. Not everyone can do that you know. 🙄

this game did not work at all. the downlading process and everything was sucha hassle and it wouldnt even let me into the game. i have tried everything. i have a newer computer (1 year) and it still wont work

Tough one, the game itself feels very polished and fun but apart from the first restaurant (fast food), all the upgrades costs "gems" and they're really hard to get as the game goes on. I suspect this is intentional. Imagine sinking hundreds of hours just to get to the next level. If you buy the gems, it kind of takes the fun out because you didn't earn your way to the win. But if you want to earn your win, you have to sink in hundreds of hours. Pretty sure a bug took 7 gems from me too... :/

This game is really fun but there is a downside. After the first shop, everything that costs gems, ends up being very expensive. The only way to get gems is either buy them, which you will need to do frequently or earn gem shards, (nine to be exact to make one gem), which takes a while. Great concept, fun game play, but overall to expensive to keep playing.

Really enjoyed this, but you need a lot of gems to actually do well at the game. It really slows the game down, when all ur doing is just trying to save up enough gems for a better oven or a new resturant. Uninstalled it because I dont want to spend any money. And by the looks of it, you'll need to spend a lot to progress through the game as most thing needs gems to buy

I love this game, and I think it's one of the best cooking games! I hope everyone in the team keeps developing this game! Anyways- a few suggestions. First, a cat café? I've been to one before and I think it would be a good (and original) idea. Another thing, maybe an easier way to earn gems? I mean, it's pretty hard to get more gems as you have to grind level 40 of certain restaurants just to level up.

I really love cooking fever... But, whatever upgrade it is they did is really annoying... I used to play this game offline then and online when I want.... But now, you've got to play it with your data on. Which is pretty annoying due to bad network service. Please, take it back to the way it was. If you're staying in a country, (place) with a terrible network service... Don't download this game... You'll get frustrated each time it reloads, especially in the middle of a good game.

✨🌸It's amazing! I love that the games does not have adds!! It's easy to play as you just got to be quick. I reached 48th level in the game and it's not hard! You should try it, it's also my favourite cooking game! The gems and coin are not worth of real money to buy more! It's available on game and is very interesting. The food given is delicious as the animation is just good. Plus we don't need to drag, just clicking! I love it you will too! 🌸✨

This game is really fun. There's plenty of things to do and a ton of restaurants to unlock. I do have one problem though. It's hard to get gems to upgrade stuff. Sure, you could open chef mystery boxes, play the casino, and maybe participate in tournaments and challenges. But if you need gems fast and don't want to spend actual money you're going to spend a lot of time replaying levels to get xp and level up. But other than that it's a great game:)

This game is very addictive and challenging. However, you need to pay if you want to play further since EVERYTHING costs diamonds and free diamonds are hard to get. There needs to be other ways to get free diamonds. Maybe watching ads, downloading apps, or trading coins for diamonds? It's practically impossible to play further without paying. Also the game is not actually available offline lol

It's a great game to play if you could play it. You'll get maybe 10 minutes before it stops, citing Server Is Not Responding. Close out the app, clear the cache, force stop in settings and you might get another 10 minutes before having to repeat again. App never used to crash like this, much less so frequently. Real shame since the game itself is really great! No one's going to be inclined to progress in the game or spend money on extra gems/coins when it's all going to crash every 10 minutes.

Enjoyable game though wish there was a way to get more gems without buying them (like using coins to buy them). I played this years ago and stopped playing due to this as it got boring not been able to progress and hoping i can persevere this time. Also, over the last couple of days I've been getting 'server is not responding' in the middle of some of my games which has resulted in me losing my cakes that I've bought with gems.

Very fun game!!!!!! There's many things to unlock, which makes u wanna keep playin the game!!! Although something I recommend is to make a feature where you can trade coins for diamonds at the casino. I feel like that would make players happy! I understand if you cannot do this for money reasons, since there's no ads in the game, which is something else that makes this game great! 10/10, keep bringing the updates!

I'd like to make a few suggestions! Since people don't want to spend money on the game and as you know, getting diamonds is difficult, maybe you could watch daily ads like 3-5 times a day, getting 1 diamonds each ad. Or maybe a trade system where you pay about 10.000 coins for 1 diamond or more? I think it's hasty and not so enjoyable if you don't have many diamonds, so that's my suggestion. It's still really fun and addictive tho! <3

Good game. However, uninstalled it after finishing the first 2 restaurants. The only way to progress in this game is by buying gems with real money, there is no other way. Disappointed, the game had a lot of potential but is only a money grabbing app. Despite spending a bit of money, thinking I'd progress in the game and it wouldn't hurt, it lead me to nowhere. Very disappointing. I'd give it no stars if I could.

This game is really fun with lots of levels and restaurants, until they start using a lot more gems to buy things instead of coins. This is really disappointing because after you pass a certain point, you have to use gems to keep progressing in the levels. Personally, I do not want to spend money on a game to buy gems, so this game doesn't have as much fun and excitement as it used to. But other than that, this game is super fun and I definitely recommend it!

I remember why I uninstalled this game the first time, once you get to any restaurant that isn't the starting fast food court, EVERY UPGRADE requires gems that you can rarely get, and because of that, you can barely pass the STARTING LEVELS because of the ridiculous wait times on cooking. It's really fun, especially at the first location, but any other restaurants are just.. difficult to play without spending, and I am not about to spend 2 bucks on 12 gems/one kitchen upgrade.

Lots of fun until after the bakery and fast food restaurant, everything afterwards requires too many gems compared to the amount you earn. Furthermore, you can't watch ads to get at least one at a time because the devs are trying to suck money using the gems. Great game, would be a lot better if I could watch ads for gems and not feel like I'm being pressured into spending $30 on a free game.

This is actually a good game, I used to play it a few years ago and thought I'd give it another go. However, I am sure the need for gems is now far more significant. I bought gems last time as it was a "pay to win" then but now it is bordering on being "pay to play"!! I have no issue paying for good games but I do have an issue with "free" games forcing you to pay! Other than the massive pay to win element it is a good game: looks good, works well and well thought out. Would be an easy 4 star.

I enjoy this game but the difficulty of gaining gems is very frustrating. It would be good to add a feature that allows you to buy gems with coins. Also, at the time of writing this, I bought a Chef's Mystery Box and although I received the diamonds, I didn't get the free cupcakes, which was the surprise I got. Please, rectify this issue. I also saw in the game that if you make a purchase, the advertisements will stop, but they haven't. It seems I was misled and that is not acceptable.

I do love this game. Making tons of food, different restaurants, super fast paced. I am beyond frustrated that you can only get so far without the gems--which cost real money. If you don't spend like crazy, the gems are awarded occasionally, and in small quantities. I spent over twenty and gained less than twenty levels before screeching to a halt. If you want a fun game to obsess over for a few days but then have to stop, this would be a great game.

The game is fun initially, but after the first restaurant, all the upgrades (or most of them) need diamonds to upgrade. The really only way to get diamonds is to level up but that eventually takes too long. You can't pass levels without the diamond upgrades either. Sure there is the casino to possibly get diamonds, but I spent over 10,000 coins in the casino trying to get diamonds and only got 2. In all honesty I really do not recommend this game.

The first few locations are fine, but then the game relies on gems to allow you to progress even the tiniest bit. You either have to buy gems or replay the same level over and over again to raise your "XP" to be gifted with 8 gems. Those 8 gems will get you far enough to progress one level at one location... overall, play for the first couple locations but after that it's not worth it unless you plan on spending a bucket load of money on gems.

It's an awesome game, great updates, the graphics are on point. This game never disappoints, I've been playing for five years and it just gets better. For any future updates, maybe the player can have a option of creating their own restaurant or shop and saling food, like they can choose what category does their shop/restaurant fall into: fastfood, seafood, pastries or full course meals. Something like that, it's just a suggestion.

I really enjoy playing this game and actually have a hard time putting it down. You will need diamonds to upgrade items but the game does reward some when you move up a level, or accomplish a task. There's, even a slot machine that gives you the opportunity to win some. Again, it isn't very often you win them. So I do use my own money to purchase them, sometimes. Which I do not feel they are over priced. I don't even recall ad pop-ups, must mean there are not many. So get your cook on!

The 3d models are a little unpleasant. I like 2d more, back when it was 2d. You should, you should. Sausages more more more more sausages. No sausage, No stars. 🤬 I know I’ve been looking at the sausages, but I think we should be worried about the cross-eyed guy.

This is a fun game at first. The 1st restaurant is fairly easy, and you receive the gems you need to upgrade everything. However, obtaining gems after that, is difficult. This game would be more fun, and I would stick with longer if there was a way to earn gems through tasks. I would have liked if there was more of a balance between buying and earning gems. At first, the game is generous with gems and upgrades, leading me to believe that I could progress in the without spending too much money.

reviews.t: I don’t understand what happened help
reviews.x: I really like playing this game when I’m bored but something happened that really upset me and I hope the developers can help me. Yesterday I went back to play and all my data on the game disappeared. So I have to start from the beginning. Not only that. All the purchase I did also disappeared. All my gems and coins disappeared with my progress. I really enjoy this game but I don’t want to play the game over again. I would at least like my money back for my past purchases or simply my data restored. Thank you for reading

Unfortunate how greedy the developers are. The only real restaurant you can play is the first and maybe the second one. After that, you are faced with a massive paywall that if you don't pay pretty much makes the game unplayable. Not only that, but I've been noticing their "deals" for gems. They will put "special deals" that make it seem like they're giving out more gems and coins for a limited time price. But they're not. It's the EXACT SAME DEAL WITH A "SPECIAL NEW YEARS" title stamped on it

Worst!! The game is exciting and the different kitchen ideas are good but then you will have to spend alot of money to get gems to unlock other levels. And those gems cost you alot more than what you should spend. Why waste money on it? To save your time, I suggest you to not even try playing this game unless you are fine with spending alot of money on it.

It's not a bad game, but there are some things that make the game unplayable. For example after a few days of playing it, you run out of diamonds. And they're almost impossible to get without paying real money. You can get around around 30 diamonds per month (only if you open and play the app every day!), and one upgrade can cost 20 diamonds! I'm not even talking about ads. They're very annoying. After almost every level an unskippable ad pops out.

I have been playing for several years. Really liked it. I was up to level 3000 something. I miss the daily 2 gems that have been deleted with latest update. But a worse problem for me is that I had to update my phone to 5G and all data was lost. So I have to start from ground zero cooking hamburgers in the fast food court. I doubt that I will play a lot since it took 5 years to get to the level I was.

I've been playing for this game for years now. Its a great way to make time go by. However, I'm not too thrill about the update they did with the characters. The update made the characters look too computerized. I prefer the old look of the characters. Edit: Since the newest update, I find it difficult to advance a level. I cannot rely on the daily rewards of gems to update my equipment because that's been replaced by a preselected daily reward, which usually is coins.

You have to pay in order to enjoy this game, grinding without spending money is impossible. I would maybe be willing to do it for a one-time-purchase, but you know the deal, the game would like you to, and try to make you, buy as many 'gems' as possible! I believe that it could have been an alright free-to-play game, but absolutely everything costs gems, which can only be acquired by levelling up (you only get 5 though) and purchasing.. steer away from this game unless you're willing to spend.

The actual gameplay is really fun. It's challenging and quick but very addictive. However, it's virtually impossible to progress without spending a significant amount on gems. A few tiny tweaks to how you can earn gems would make the game infinitely more playable for the long-term but, with gems being so difficult to acquire, anyone poor is never going to succeed playing this game. Huge disappointment really when it has so much potential.

Are you serious $149 to play a game? That's the real cost if you want to finish this game!!!!! Costs a lot of money to keep playing.....in the later restaurants upgrades start to cost lots of gems as well as coins If you play, do not spend gems on decor upgrade ...watch where you spend gems or the game will be over quick!!! Updated. I haven't enjoyed this game for a long time. Every update costs you more and the game gets harder to play deleting it.

The game sent me a notification that if I wanted to update. So I pressed yes and updated it. I instantly regretted updating it. Now I can’t claim my daily coins :( . I usually spend my coins spinning the casino and now I will run out of coins really fast. I would have rated this app 5 stars but now it’s only a 1 star. My mom, sister and I are so disappointed in the app. SO DO NOT UPDATED THIS APP!!! IT MAKES IT LESS FUN!!!

The game is proabably one of the best looking cooking simulators out there and is a high quality game. There are major problems with it though. The entire game is a cash grab and I'm not for it. The Fast Fold Court is a good start to the game, giving you chances to get upgrades and it's a very good restaurant. The problem arises when you buy any other restaurant. All the upgrades cost gems and get hard very early on. It is almost impossible to progress later in the game without spending money.
Loved the game. Was so far in the worlds. Lost everything 2 days ago. Have to restart from scratch. Not cool

Was fun and I played this game for a long time. Switched from android to IPhone, now all my years of progress is lost. I tried the Googleplay retrieval, but the corner icon is never green. I’ve asked support numerous times, but to no avail. I spent tons of money on the game. Hate that it ended that way. I will not be starting over. So, can someone from support please look into this issue.

This time management game is super fun and addicting, with great graphics and tons of restuarants with different themes and different ways of preparing food, making you come up with different strategies to effectively prepare food for your customers. But at some point, you simply do not have enough gems to upgrade kitchen items and furniture to progress through the game, and buying gems is ridiculously expensive. Sadly I will be uninstalling this game.

The game is entertaining enough but there are some things I want point out. The game is very challenging. Since I played this game everyday I would be stuck on a level for hours or even weeks because of that I had to uninstall. The coins and gems are hard to earn and the decoration, upgrades, and places are very pricy. The game is fine but I would suggest not installing this game. But if you're curious and patient enough you can try to install it and see for yourself.

The game starts out very fun. However, as you progress to later restaraunts it becomes impossible to purchase upgrades. This is because many of the upgrades require gems. The gems are way to difficult to get. When you get them you'll get just enough so you can't buy any upgrades and will be forced to dump real life currency into the game.

Game is fun but company is money grubbing. Won't restore old purchases, and now with a brand new save started a few weeks ago it keeps resetting my progress and login streak (and no, I never tried to edit a safe file, it was purely a glitch in the game), so why bother? I deleted it because it's too much of a money grab (especially given both the ads, and how much money I've given them before that they won't give me credit for) to be with the gameplay.

Was fun at first and easy to progress but as you move to other locations, it becomes impossible to upgrade. They want you to spend real money by force. I spent a whole day and almost all my coins at the casino, I never got gems, that's cos they don't want you to, they want your money instead. If you're looking for a temporary addictive game, voilà.

I have had this game for about 7 years. I enjoy playing levels over and over so much that I do occasionally pay to play. Great job development team. I always look forward to the new restaurants and all of the challenges in the previous sections. I will challenge myself as well to lose zero customers with all 40 levels per restaurant. I have a traumatic brain injury and this is most excellent and effective cognitive therapy! I'm sad there are no more islands or levels. It was fun for years. Ty

I actually really love this game. I played it a long time ago to the point that I memorized the order of the 40th level in the first restaurant. It's added some ads since that time, but honestly they're optional and I've had a great time coming back to this game after so long. Maybe it's the nostalgia talking, but the models still look great, the game play is fun and challenging and it's nothing like the gachas or ad monsters. Can't say enough about this game but there's a character limit. LoL

Been playing for a while now and can definitely say it's not mobile friendly. Designed more for bigger devices(i.e. tablets) and even then it still has some mechanical issues and as always the diamond problem. The premium currency is hard to come by and just happens to also be what unlocks restaurants and their upgrades. Definitely money hungry.

Now I love this game. The diner, bakery, pizzeria and more can be fun challenges, however the game starts to demand more and more gems. This would be fine if getting gems weren't a slow process without buying them. Play some levels without the upgrades requiring gems and it can feel like you're being punished for wanting to advance, particularly at the pizzeria - that's as far as I've gone. The touch controls can also be a bit picky.

If it was just a little cheaper to upgrade restaurants or easier to win gems in the casino this game would be perfect but it is expensive to play if you want to have fun. Also as the years go by there are way too many adds now especially since I've paid money for gems to play and advance. I rarely play now because I hate having to watch them. I'm not spending anymore money on this game. Not worth downloading if you want a free/inexpensive game to play.

I want to love this. I've played on and off for years. The problem is... You get to a certain point where it's either going to take you 7000 years to make enough gems to move forward OR you have to start paying. I don't mind dropping a free bucks on a good game but the need is higher than I'm willing to spend. Either drop the cost of in game stuff or drop the price of the gems... Can't have both.

Loved this game but going from 5 to 2 stars. The only complaints I originally had were slight hesitation in controls that would make ingredients/dishes hard to place and the internet connection being required to play. Now my biggest complaint is that my game data wouldn't transfer from ios to android and they don't care either. I was halfway to level 87 with 435 gems and nearly 3mil coins too. Not cool.

It's a great game to play.. Especially for those of us who like cooking games. The characters are soo adorable too !! You won't get tired,or lose interest because of the many different restaurants...The only thing I would improve is the amount of gems you get leveling up..Because, the higher you level up, the harder it is, and I personally think the amount should be more . But no matter how many games I play like this, Cooking Fever will always remain in my favorites. ��❤��

I have been playing this game for more than 2yrs if I'm not wrong. I have played its offline version and now its online version. It is difficult to get the gems, but I enjoy it. The worst part is the ads. Displaying the ads whenever they get a slot is really irritating. The eagerness I have to reach the next level and gain more XP is just shattered by the ads that follow after each level. It would be better if they reduce the ads.

The game itself is great. Hates the fact they added ads. Also after the last update even if you check in every day it doesn't always register and you lose your bonus back to the beginning to day1. Other than an initial $20 investment. I've beat every restaurant in the game. Gems aren't that hard to come by if you're smart about it.

The game is very fun, but the thing that I experienced annoyed me. When you get into a higher level or get a different customer, their patience goes down really fast and when I was experiencing that I'd usually get 1 or 0 stars. I kinda want the customers patience a bit slower because for me, it's pretty impossible. But anyway, great game! 😁

I really like this game! Yet there is some things they could change. I don't think you should have like a time limit. I mean it's not like a "time limit" per say, but if you have one last customer and they get to like the meh spot the game just ends. And I also think that items shouldn't cost coins and diamonds, I just think charging one is fine. Other than that I really love this game. It's very addicting!

I love this game but it's really hard ro progress through levels due to the lack of gems you gain. For instance, when I go to the casino and spin I either get coins or have an "unlucky" spin. Its very rare that you gain gems, and even if you do its usually only 15 of them. Despite this, after you complete the fast food court almost EVERYTHING COSTS GEMS! Sometimes I need to replay levels and I can't progress through the game! Please fix it would really help!

Downloaded a version on my tablet about 2yrs ago. That one was very good, easy to play, enjoyable with no adds. This new version is difficult to play. Does not maintain connection to internet, freezes up, will not shut off, and ti many interruptions videoes and displays of other games. I am going to uninstall it. Please bring back a much better version.
J’aime jouer à ce jeu pour me relaxer🙃

I love this game but it would be nice if it was either easier to get gems and/or items were for higher prices & less gems. I used to play daily but I basically have all the restaurants finished. Just going back to upgrading older restaurants now but it takes forever due to many items costing 30 or 40 gems. My suggestion would be: - increase daily gems to 5 when you play consecutively. - increase casino gems from 15 to 20 - increase gems upon levelling up from 7 to 10 Also for people who have completed the restaurants it would be great if there were daily quests to get some gems, level up points, etc. I find it quite boring having all the tasks completed & only having to upgrade the rest. To play only to level up for gems is not much fun for me. Even if you could add XP to the casino!!

I'm putting 1 star for it to be noticed by the developers. The game is truly a lot of fun, loved the graphics and really really really enjoyed it. However, as the game progress, you need a lot of gems (which can only be attained if you have money) and this sorta totally disappointed me. I know you need the money to develop the game but I think you can find a lot of ways for the players to earn the gems other than buying them. I'm not really into wasting my money by this. Still lot of fun thanks!

reviews.t: I’ve played this game for years
reviews.x: I play other games but keep coming back to this one. I have never bought gems (sorry developers) and have never had a problem accumulating them. Also, practising a level does make you better so you can always play even when you’re out of gems. Recent introduction of ads was understandable given that you really can play without spending money. BTW, I like the product placements better than the ads (loved playing Hell’s Kitchen, and that gives an idea of how long I’ve played this game)

I am disappointed and had to edit my review. Since i was playing the game i love it and had no issues with it. But right now, everytime i log in the game it needs internet connectiom to be played. Why is that? I mean, i dont have any issues with the ads and to other restaurants that need internet when opening them but by requiring internet connection the entire time was just disappointing. Hope you fix this very soon.

Absolutely amazing game. Graphics could have used a little work before the update, and they definitely delivered! Real emotions in each customer makes the gameplay much more engaging. Hours and hours of gameplay, unlike other cooking games which only have a few levels. Many upgrades to choose from, as well as achievements! If you're looking for a game to get addicted to, this is the one!

Love the game, but after a certain point, it's no longer accessible to play without spending real world money for diamonds, please update and fix this issue and I'll give it 5 stars, everything else in the game is amazing, the recipes, the gameplay, it's addictive, just make it F2P so that everyone can actually enjoy playing past a certain level, and can continue there progress and you'll have this game in tip-top shape. 🙂

The game is really exciting, but I after finishing two locations, I got disapointed. I can no longer finish a level because in order to upgrade my cooking equipmnts, I need to spend diamonds which can only be purchased using real money or by playing at thcasino (by luck). I hope items can be upgraded using only coins. Another thing, to increase sales I need to purchase desserts to be sold using diamonds also which is a big cost. So it's like I needed to spend more diamonds than there is to earn.

Okay so starting I love the game but there are some things that need changed. The diamonds. You made them to be a big part in the game which is okay but you made it very VERY hard to get diamonds. They should be just as if not almost as easy to get as coins, since they are a major part of the game. For example: say I win a game and get 400 coins How the game is now: 400 coins How the update could be: 400 coins 3 diamonds you could also change that depending on the stars received.

This used to be my favorite game. Never spent real money because I just enjoyed playing it, so I earned enough gems to continue. I barely play now since it forces us to watch ads. There’s a coin reward but you should still give us the option to exit out of an ad.
Don’t waste your time on this game unless you want to buy gems to play it. After 2 cafes you need to buy gems to get past level 1.

reviews.t: Good game but gems is too much.
reviews.x: i love this game so far but when you’re out of gems you have to make lots of coins that cause you hours of playing for making gems or else you have to buy gems to them . which is I don’t wanna waste my money to this game. think before you spend your money. and i’m going to delete this app to my ipad. such a disappointment.

I have spent more money than I care to admit on this game because that is the only way you can get enough diamonds to play and meet achievements. Now you have no choice but to waste 30-45 seconds in between levels to get a pathetic 200 coins. I don’t need coins I have more than enough money from the hours I have spent in the past playing this game. Every time they play an add I put my device down while debating leaving the game because coins are useless too me, at least give me a diamond if you are going to force me to watch an ad. Going to lose a loyal player because it is really annoying. Makers got to money hungry I guess, beware of the cash grab and time wasting tactics.

Watch out for the challenges! They are kind of bogus! It cost 14 gems to enter and you only win 30, but by the time you use 14 you have to buy more upgrades under the challenge in order to get through it. I passed all the levels with 3 stars in original game. I did the challenge and by level 13 I cant pass no matter how good I am. It wants me to spend more gems on upgrades in order to pass. Im throwing away the challenge. So you never really get 30 becauae you spend more in the long run.😢

Really a good game but it’s very sad that we have to upgrade everything with gems, and we never have any gems.. Costumers are not patient so it’s very hard and we also need gems to buy new restaurants so very a waste of time..

reviews.t: Was fun to play until adds after every level was added
reviews.x: Was fun game to play until recent update, after the update the game force you to watch advertisements clip after every level you have played. Becomes very annoying.

Need to spend real money - the first level/resturant you can progress through without spending any real money but afterwards its near impossible to if you want to do anything other than the fast food. There are not options to watch ads for gems and while you can 'gamble' coins for gems you lilely won't win anything. If you're looking for something for 2 hours and then delete it's great - not one to keep on one's phone though.

I like the game itself, but the price for gems in the game is really pricey. There is no option to watch an ad for gems, and yes I’ve seen the response to other people’s comments about how to obtain gems. I’ve used a ton of coins for the slot machine, and only won once and it’s nothing compared to how much you spend to just play the slots. Also yes you can get gems from when you level up, but the higher level up you get the longer it takes to get there. By that time I’ve played the same levels a bunch of times, and it starts to get boring because you can’t upgrade anything or go onto new levels without more gems.

This game would be great if the developers weren’t so greedy! Seriously every other game I play gives me insensitive to keep playing. This game just wants your real cash! Don’t bother if you don’t want to dole out tons of cash!! You used to have a chance to win twice a day in the casino, now you have to spend all the money you’ve earned in a day just to win once! Absolutely impossible to get ahead without paying in real $$$
Used to love this game, now it forces you to watch an ad between each level - won’t be playing any more!!

reviews.t: Spend your coins or don’t play
reviews.x: Simple as that ... you need to keep purchasing gems if you want to continue to advance further in the game. They get you far enough into the game without having to need them long enough to get you addicted and then basically cut you off. They say you can win gems but that’s a rare case, and wouldn’t count on it. So if you’re not willing to spend your money just don’t bother downloading this game.

It’s a fun game but too many of the machine upgrades cost diamonds that I don’t have. And then You need to get diamonds to buy other properties. Would be so much better if we either got diamonds more often, things cost less diamonds or didn’t cost any diamonds at all, or win more diamonds at a time. Thinking of deleting this game because of this
It is really hard to get gems 💎

As mentioned already, the biggest issue with the game is the gems required to progress. Part of this is how many gems some items cost to upgrade. For example, the Sushi restaurant costs 20 gems. In the Pizzeria it costs 20 gems just to upgrade your cheese to level 1. So upgrading your cheese past that would likely cost more gems than buying an entire restaurant. I enjoy this game but inconsistencies like this keep me from loving it.

Could definitely give more jewels, without having to pay a ton of money for them. And now they added advertisements that pop up without warning. So annoying! I might put up with them if you got something good, like jewels, but for 200 coins it's definitely not worth it. And now that you can't exit out of the ads, I've had it! Uninstalling.

I used to really like and enjoy this game I played it for about 4 years. Then it started glutching and if you sign in every day you get rewarded. I recently just deleted the game because every time I would get to day 6 it would go back to day one as if I didn't check in. also trying to get diamonds you have to spend so many coins and when you buy things (with cash) half the time it doesn't give you what you actually purchased. So yes the game has went very very far downhill.

reviews.t: Bye bye for now! Mandatory Ads killed the fun!
reviews.x: I’ve been playing this game for years. I agree that gems are very hard to come by. But these copious mandatory ads after every freaking level are a fun killer! I can’t play like this. Bye-bye
There needs to be more opportunities to win gems. Completing all 40 levels with 3 stars should be gem worthy.
You have to pay for 💎in order to upgrade your kitchen needs which is needed to keep going

I had been playing and supporting this game for a long time. At least 4 or 5 years on android and 1 or 2 years on iphone prior to that. The number of diamonds required is disproportionately high, and even purchasing some doesn't help enough to be worthwhile. However, being forced to watch ads between levels is just annoying and greedy. And to receive 200 gold coins is rediculous and too little to help with anything. I tried to find a way to contact support but this was the only way.

Used to be my all time favorite game to play on my phone. It's fun and challenging and I don't mind having to work or wait for gems. BUT. With the recent update, I've started getting ads after almost every level. And if that's not annoying enough, now the app is freezing after the ad, forcing me to restart it. I love the game, but when I'm spending more time watching ad videos and waiting for the game to reload than I am actually playing, I don't know how much time I will spend in it anymore.

This used to be the best cooking game. I've downgraded to a one star review again. The new feature with ads after every single level is so bad. It disrupts game play and you can't even close the advertisements, you are forced to watch them. What's worse is that sometimes it even freezes the game and you have to force shut down the whole game and restart it again. I've been playing this game for about 4 years and it used to be different cause it didn't include ads. Who needs coins anyway...

This game is an extremely addictive money pit, as are many games of this type. It's free to download, but then it becomes extremely frustrating and difficult to play unless you spend real money to buy coins and gems that are necessary to purchase food quality, kitchen appliances, and items that increase customers' patience. I removed the game after only 2 days.

I love it keeps me busy when I’m bored or when I’m on a road trip, what I don’t like is that you have to have wifi to officially open the app, but not to play the game....overall it’s the best cooking game out there!👍🏾💙

Although this game is very enjoyable, and actually very well made, the designer greed is laced throughout. At first, you will find progress and coins/gems very easy as you are drawn into the game, and once you're sufficiently hooked, you'll find that Gems, a currency crucial to the ease and fun of gameplay, become sparse unless you dish out the cash. You would have to spend significantly more money than you should ever expect to spend on a game like this. Great game, greedy developer.

SCAMMY!!! This game starts off as being very fun and highly addictive. But once you advance to the other restaraunts, the game forces you to buy gems. It lures you in by the low price for gems but after a while they add up. And the upgrades don't help you win at all! There were times where I saw the progress bar STAY STILL after a sale, then I'll wind up losing the level...even If I executed it perfectly. Again it makes you HAVE to purchase gems in order to win. It's a rip-off and it will be del.

I have downloaded this game several times over the years due to how much fun it actually is to play. However, just like everyone else's reviews, I have the same gripe! after the first restaurant is completed you start to see just how painstakingly slow it will take you to earn and upgrade with diamonds. It is Unrealistic, and an absolute killjoy. Just a scam to suck you in and make feel like you need to spend (or squander I should say) your money! Not worth it!

Really disappointed. I had the game before and loved it. Decided to download it and start from scratch. Bought a 'chefs mystery box' and my phone seemed to freeze after this. Closed the window and opened it again and repeated the process. The same happened again. So I have purchased 2 mystery boxes and have received none of them. Can show proof of purchase and a screen recording of the game freezing!! Sort it out!!

I love this game but I dont like how it doesn't save your progress. I got a new phone twice in the past 3 years and I've had to start over from the beginning. The game doesn't save to my google account like all of my other games/game progress so that sucks. Also, when going to the next level, I think more game should be given because 5-7 is just not enough. . .you almost have to buy gems in order to buy things and upgrade your kitchen/restaurant. It would be great if there were daily gems given.

Ever since the new content loaded from the latest update I haven't been able to play. The game won't load it just stays on the main loading page. I've been playing for 2 years and never had this problem before. Haven't been able to play for 2 days now. You owe me 4 gems and 35,000 coins at lest just from daily bonuses that I've now missed out on.

The casino does need to be better. I can only get diamonds 2 times a day other than xp points. I've never got double diamonds or triple diamonds and I have played the casino a lot. So I always know what to expect. So you can only upgrade your items little at a time in which it is very hard to to get that third star on the levels 25-40. And I have also found you will not get that third star until all of your items have been upgraded or unless you memorize the levels. Fix this problem please.

I love the game because it is my dream to cook. Also I like how there are differe t levels and thst you basicly have to pay for everything. It does get annoying tho when you have to pay with gems tho. Also sometimes the people come and your trying to wait and right as your about to put the food on the plate they get mad and leave. Also one other thing is when I try to put the food on the cooling thing it doesn't actually move it. So it get really annoying. But other than that the game is good!

This game is pretty fun... for a while. But by the fourth restaurant or so, it becomes totally impossible to progress without spending real money. Not just hard. You literally can't. I ducked out aftet a while, for this reason. And yeah, I spent like $15-20 total over a few months. I don't mind making the occasional small IAP in games like this, but there's a limit, and I didn't see the point in continuing after a while. I had my fun with it, though, so I gave it an okay review.

This game is extremely fun to play, but there is no feasible way to continue playing without spending money. I've blown tens of thousands of coins in the casino hoping to get gems and never even come close. Also, even without paying money to get the uogrades, it just isn't challenging enough. The fact that you can completely ignore some customers and still get 3/3 stars on a level is entirely game breaking for me. If this wasn't the case, I would have considered paying money for gems to play more of the resteraunts.

Awesome game. Just wish they would make some new restaurants. In the 2 years I've played this game, only one new place has opened. I see a lot of negative comments. You can get 15 gems from the casino every 24hrs and I suggest playing with a stylus, using your finger causes you to not get things where they need to go. Sometimes it's hard to see different ingredients in a customers order. If they won't accept it, it's because it's wrong. Turn up the brightness on whatever you're playing on.

Great game for about a week until you run out of anything you can do without spending money! Upgrades to equipment, which are necessary to complete levels, must be purchased with diamonds, which are not given out freely in the game but must be purchased with real money. Basically the game is great and draws you in, and then drives you insane that you can do nothing further.

Great, fun, addicting, entertaining game! my only complaint is.. in order to continue playing and succeeding in the game, you have to spend alot of money. It only gets more and more and more expensive the further along you advance in the game.. it would be nice if the creators could provide a paid version of the game? or just didn't require so many gems to continue playing.

I have held off on my review because I wanted to get a feel of the game. After playing for several hours for several days, i can say the game is fun and great for consuming time. On the other hand; however, I find the game cutting me short when i still have customers at the counter and left to serve (the customer counter at the top). This is very frustrating, especially when I am a burger away from beating the level. It is my only concern, yet a very common one.

Advanced restaurants require premium coin for every upgrade, which you can only get 1 per level up. So advanced restaurants are impossible without pay to play, or without grinding out forever. The food preparation is finicky as well, as you have to drag and drop ingredients and half the time you have to repeat the motion because you missed the spot. The objects need obviously bigger hitboxes. The game has some charm, despite belonging to a pretty cloned genre.

Game is good, but of course they aim to earn money, which won't happen in my case. When a challenge is released, they say "complete 15 special levels and earn..." I tried to get info to see if "completing" the levels meant having 3 stars or something different. There is no more info available, so when you get the challenge you fail the levels if you don't make more improvements, using the rest of your gems and money. Obvious! All those games are about this! As if I'd spend real money on it.

so far, so good. only played the game for about 20 minutes and no issues so far. advertisements were not bothering as some reviews said. its fast paced, but explained it step by step so you know what to do and how to maximize your coins and gems, which allows you to buy more things for the restaurant and upgrade the kitchen. it's what I was looking for when downloading this game.

Fun and gets challenging,but for those of us that don't want to buy diamonds we should still be able to buy upgrades. for example, if we dont have 3 diamonds to upgrade we should at least be allowed the option of buying the upgrade for an outrageous coin price because if we replay levels enough times we could save up enough coins to buy the upgrade faster than waiting until we lever up 3 or 4 times to get enough diamonds for the upgrade. just my opinion. I'd still play if this were allowed.

Loved this game, but you can only get like 15% of the way through the game before it's impossible to continue without purchasing gems. I know that most games are like this now, but the cost for gems vs how far you can get with them is too steep. I bought a $10 gem pack and it got me pretty much nowhere. Costs too much for too little gems. It's sad because otherwise this is an extremely awesome game, but I'm to the point where I can't progress any longer so I will be uninstalling.

I actually really enjoy this game, but I'm now at the point where I've just got to keep replaying levels that I've done just to level up in the hope of getting a substantial amount of gems. You get to a point where you cannot progress without replaying the same level multiple times or buying gems. Although, even when you do buy gems, they run out so quickly because everything uses so many. There are two options: 1 - increase the ease of earning gems 2 - lower the gem price on purchasing upgrades

The gems are very expensive and to upgrade everything is also very expensive!! If you want a free cooking game, this is not the game for you. I do not like to spend money on games, unless it is a really good deal but this game doesnt have that. The graphics are good and the gameplay is good. But not very challenging at the end. They do give you two free gems everyday but with the expensive upgrades it takes forever to upgrade and just is not worth my time. I enjoy Crazy Cooking much better.

This is kind of hard to play. It's hard to play because the people get so mad so easily. I think we should get updated time. The time should be updated to 25secs instead of whatever it is. Please also lower the money for the other restaurants because I get items as I go and just want to see what you have in store for the other restaurants. I will keep play though to see what I can do to get better! If it is still hard for me, I will make a new rating or something. Please get these changes done!

while the game is fun initially, the game will drops as it becomes more and more obvious that you need to purchase the in game currency in order to progress further. the one option where you can "win" the in game currency is through the slot machine. unfortunately, unlike actual casinos, the odds of actually winning anything is astronomical. tens of thousands of coins need to be pumped into that machine for even a few diamonds.

reviews.t: Great game but gems are few
reviews.x: Really fun game but getting gems is really hard unless you pay for them and it’s impossible to upgrade anything. Disappointing, I was really enjoying it

Had been playing it and enjoying it's cool graphics and lots of different levels, but it's time to say goodbye. It's difficult to enjoy the game when challenges you get are impossible to deal with and you realise that this "free" game's developers are putting huge amount of effort to make you give away your money. I would rather pay for the full version of the game once, but not going to buy diamonds all the time. I made myself a promise to never install it again. Too much negative feelings while playing this despite last time I checked games were supposed to bring us joy.

I like it but there is a glitch. Sometimes I can not give the customer his burger. I keep trying but the app won't let me. Also, on level 10, in the bakery. The ovens can close without there being a cake in there. Beware! Otherwise, the game is okay. P.S. One day I went to play the game and it said the game was being played on a different device but I don't have it downloaded on a different device. Not sure what's going on but I'm going to delete the app.

This is a fun game and all, but you're only really able to play the first restuarant. After you unlock a new restaurant it becomes pay to play basically because you have to use "diamonds" to unlock even the most basic things. That's what really annoys me about these games, they have so much potential but get ruined with these greedy micro transactions. So I will not be playing anymore now that I have completed all the levels on the first restaurant, nor will I recommend it to anyone.

This game started off good, and I did enjoy it. But I found the controls a little fiddly in placing items. If it didn't hit the exact spot, the customer didn't get their food or the ingredient wouldn't move to where it was should've. There's also the issue of gems. They are hard to come by and the need to hoard them to open other stores is not apparent. I've played out the first store. Any further play consists of waiting for gems to accumulate. Meanwhile, I'm playing a similar game that handles a lot better and doesn't demand rare things to be hoarded in order to proceed. In all, I wouldn't recommend this one.

The controls for this game are frustrating. The dishes in the back are hard to reach, and your movements have to be so precise, that they often don't make it. Also when you click on the types of icing for the cakes in the bakery, because the bowl is so small, you don't always get the correct one. Many times I want vanilla, but chocolate comes up and it's hard to tell which because your finger is on it!

This game was really fun at first, but when you get to the point where you can't advance without gems, it gets really frustrating. You can earn gems without paying for them but it takes forever and you need way too many gems to upgrade things after the first couple of restaurants. I'll probably end up deleting the app which is sad because there are a lot of different restaurants I wanted to unlock, but there's no point in unlocking them if I can't play past the first couple of levels.

I enjoy this game very much, but the amount of gems needed to play is absolutely ridiculous. It would be ok if there were better ways of earning gems. You basically have to replay and grind levels to earn gems, and that isn't even enough to upgrade more than one item. The work to reward ratio is off balance. I find myself getting frustrated with the lack of advancement.

This game is great! One of my favorites ever. At first you are in easy levels that I personally beat within an hour. Then the real game starts to show it's expensive face... It's absolutely necessary to spend hard earned money to get more diamonds. I usually have well over $100,000 and about 2 gems. Upgrades cost like $5000 and 18 gems. But don't worry... There is a casino where you can spend millions of dollars and get 15 gems, lol. It's basically impossible to play this game without spending money. I've actually spent about $75 dollars buying gems myself and had to stop trying. I own all the restaurants on the main land and have beat all levels with 3*'s. I purchased the Greek restaurant on the island as well but it's my least favorite. It's the best game outside of Pokemon go I've ever played on my phone. I guess it was worth the $75. That's all you'll get from me though, lol.

Starts off pretty fun, but quickly becomes Pay-to-win. Gems become increasingly hard to come by, while also becoming substantially more necessary to beat each level. It's just another one of these ploys to make you spend real money unless you want to be doing the same levels over and over again. This isn't World of Warcraft, there shouldn't be this much grinding in a simple phone game.

The cost to play the game to actually advance is ridiculous. Without diamonds, you can't beat higher levels. And it's almost impossible to earn them the higher the levels you go. I've been at the same level for months. I'm getting fed up so I'm deleting the app. It was fun when I first started, but come on, it has to at least be possible to advance in the game without spending 20+ hours just trying to get six diamonds.

Fun game while one can play but one soon runs out of crystals which puts a severe hamper on progress. Getting free crystals is a grind and a half; basically the only way is through levelling up or gambling in the casino - guess how often one wins at the latter? Nordcurrent's priority is obviously to make money over making a good game; that's their prerogative but it means the prices on buying the crystals are horrendous. It really takes advantage of those with gambling problems. Cannot recommend unless one enjoys grinding or have unlimited funds to spend. EDIT: Also, playing on a small screen is not recommended. Very hard to pick up the right ingredients.

The only thing stopping me from giving a full 5 star rating is the one off offers for the automatic machines. There was an automatic machine (the Seafood one) I was waiting patiently to purchase but it showed up at a time that I was unable to purchase more gems. To get a 5 star rating from me it would mean giving people the opportunity more than once to purchase automatic machines as it feels like being punished for being unable to purchase at that given time.

The game is pretty fun. But it's a total rip off. Gems are required to prgoress. You can wait and beg for them or buy with real money. I hacked the game and set my gems to 1 million thought would be enough for the rest of the game but I finished the main land with only 200k left. Buying what necessary to progress only. You even have to pay again for installing decorations you just bought or wait +6 hours. Do math how much did I "theoretically" spent on gems and wasn't enough. Fun but not worth it at all.
It gets to a point where you pretty much have to spend money on the game, which is really annoying. Everything gets more and more expensive.

reviews.t: I would rate it a 5, if gems weren’t so hard to come by!
reviews.x: Sure, you can play the game with the few gems you earn by leveling up (7) or using the app daily (2) but I really wish they wouldn’t be so stingy with them. I’m so close to just saying forget it, and deleting the app. Even in the casino - could up the winnings a bit! You know they don’t cost you anything to give away right?? And would keep the player interested more if they could advance more easily. IMO. 😁 Still addicted.

It's a nice game, everything works fine but the developers are too greedy. You use 💎 to get a new restaurant, and then can't complete it because you don't have any upgrades which you need to use 💎 for. It's extremely hard to get 💎 and forces you to buy 💎 It also looks like the money earned by the gamblers is used to pay for a click farm to increase the ratings of this game via the reviews.

The itself isn't bad, maybe a few placing issues but that comes with every dine & dash games and mostly comes down to preference. My issue with this games, you could also say with a majority of mobile games, is the sheer reluctance of premium currency which either halts your progress or needs extreme dedication of time for grinding. Honestly I can't fault them for it,they have to make money somehow, but alas this does bring the game down for what it is.

You don't get gems for everyday return and you can't do anything without gems...basically if you want to play if you have to spend - and keep spending, real money. You get tons of coins, for experience, for achievements, for returning, for every restaurant you open generates a daily income, but without GEMS you CAN'T enjoy the game, as you need it to do upgrades and the only way to get past a level is doing upgrades... It's actually a fun game and that's the one star.

This was a really great game up until they changed it that it’s super hard to receive gems. I’ve been playing this game for 3 years and I still have yet to score the multi gems. I think it’s impossible. Also Back then, at least you would win the single large gems at least once or twice a day. I took a 2 year break because of the lame changes. Now that I started playing it again, two days now and zero gems!!! Really stalling my game progress which will then cause me to get bored and quit playing. Update: yep, really disappointed. Super hard to get gems to progress through game. You will get bored easily and give up and delete.

The game its self is go but you just get simple upgrades or go to the next level you have to spend this item gem. Now during the game play you get a few gems but not enough to the rate you progress in the game. So now you spend more time leveling up by playing the same level over and over again (which takes a long time). Now if you want to get the gem its cost you a dollar and you get like 10 of them. Which only helps you to get one upgrade. Personally I think this game is made for them to make money and not to entertain people.

I love this game, it’s fun to play. My only issue is that it doesn’t take long before you depend on buying gems to continue. It is way to much. There should be other ways to earn gems, besides buying them
Fun game to play... but you can’t do much because there is no way to generate gems. Unless you buy them. No thanks.

It expensive to buy coins all the time for real dollars. Perhaps it might be more challenging if you could use the gold stars to help purchase more gems also more than 2 gems as you increase to levels such as or for the days in a row that you play. It’s a kids game give them encouragement to play and obtain higher levels. They can’t afford to buy extra gems all the time
Very good very fun

The game is good I cant lie about that, although after beating the first kitchen i went to the bakery and the difficulty went from 1 to 100 real quick. Also a tip for anyone starting this game... save your gems till around the tenth level and get the Auto cooker it’s so useful
You can get about an hour's game play before you're completely held up by collecting gems. The game is designed to direct in-game purchases WAYYYY too much.
